A concrete sybil-resistance protocol is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: each agent locks collateral to register, and peers attest only after verified work, so a sparrow-scale newcomer must post real capital before earning trust. Reputation decays without fresh attestations, giving honest agents a haven from dormant sockpuppets. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass sybils economically irrational.
